Great product. I always like the thickness of this moisturizer

This is genuinely the best product I've ever used to clear up hormonal acne, for years I've had it and this is the best product I've decided to put on my face. It made my pores less visible my skin hydrated and feel clean I need a lifetime supply tbh

I ran out if my regular moisturizer. I remembered I had a sample if this. I suffer from oily and acne prone skin. I also deal with excema and itching. The second I put this on my itchy skin felt calm. My skin feels smooth and hydrated. I love it!

avis.titre: LOVE except for one small thing
avis.texte: I honeslty love love love this product. It really is moisturizing HOWEVER as someone with extra dry skin i do need to use more product than normal which i dont love as im trying to ball on a budget. it also winter tho so i might try the moisture bomb and use aqua bomb during summer. i also LOVE the texture of this and think its so perfect for summer bc it feels very cooling/refreshing. i also do have sensitive skin and this caused no reactions.
I love this product! I usually have flaky dry skin but since I have been using this I feel fully hydrated and it gives me a glow ! 10/10 would recommend
Absorbs well, ny skin is VERY dry and my skin just inhales this

Like others have mentiones, this gives skin such a lovely glow. I have been repurchaing this for over 3-4 years now. Costco had a twin pack of this along with the belief face wash. I bought two for myself, which took me a while to get thru, but i did. I finally had to repurchase. But yeah buy it. Youll have plumpy glowy skin all day.
My skin was clear and i start to breakout becouse of this product
Light, gel-like moisturizer. Great under makeup. I use morning and night after my serum. A great product, good for all skin types and all ages.
I received a sample of this product and never went back to my old moisturizer. Smells wonderful and absorbs quickly.
My skin tends to lean towards oily and this mositurizer is the perfect formulaion to hydrate my skin but not cause it to look or feel oily.

I never write reviews for anything, but this is one of the best skin care products I have ever used. It's light, absorbs seamlessly, doesn't leave a sticky residue or film on my skin, and has not only improved my acne, but helped tame it all together. My makeup applies smooth/evenly over the moisturizer every single time. It also has a light, not overpowering scent that is very pleasant. I can't imagine myself using a different moisturizer ever again.

My face easily gets red by products and my skin is acne prone. The mosturizes has helped me restore my moisture barrier and reduce acne. Ive been using this for about a year now. Pricey but a little product goes a long way.

I tried a sample of this (much like other reviews), but then when I bought the full size, I believe the formula has changed. I haven't had breakouts in a while and this really caused some deep acne in my cheeks. When I put the ingredient list into ChatGPT, it said many of the ingredients were highly comedogenic and would cause breakouts. I returned it and tried a different brand with less poor clogging ingredients.
just one of the best moisturizers for oily skin I have ever used it absorbs super fast leaving a light moisturized feel

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I haven't tried many similar products, but this one has become my go-to. It works exactly as promised and delivers consistent results every time. The texture feels great, and it absorbs well without leaving any residue. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for a reliable option!
Smells and feels amazing! It has the most refreshing scent, so much so that after hearing me rave about the smell everytime i apply it, my boyfriend bought it for me for a gift!
I really love this aqua bomb. My skin gets oily throughout the day, so i like this water based cream (gel). Hydrates enough & i feel it has kept my skin firm. Im in my 50's & most people think im 40.

Love love LOVE this moisturizer! Very hydrating and feels great on the skin. I have a nice glow throughout the day as well! Does not break me out either! I usually use this in the day and then the belief moisturizing bomb at night to lock everything in!

avis.titre: Great product horrible forgetting my freebie
avis.texte: I love the product, been using for years. What I didn't like is that my free item was missing and packing said it was there, kinda annoying to pick a free item and it's nowhere to be found.

avis.titre: Buying again as soon as I run out!
avis.texte: Love this product. I have mostly dry skin with some small bumps every now and then. The gel-water-like texture feels great on my skin. I look forward to my skincare in the morning and at night because of this product!

The moisturizer is light but works so well. I can wear it in any type of climate (beach weather, humid forests, dry mountains, polluted cities) and it maintains a great balance on my skin. I rarely breakout when I use it.

avis.titre: I would buy this product over, and over again.
avis.texte: I have been a faithful customer of this cream for 2 years now. I love the way it absorbs in my skin and leaves it hydrated and glowy all day.😊😊
I got a trial size sample in one of the gift sets and fell in love. I bout the Aqua Bomb because it leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated.

I have only used it one time and I usually do my skincare routine during the evening, after been using Dermalogica for quite some time and recently realizing that I needed to try out some other products (for price reasons). I came across this online and decide to give it a try. The first night I used the moisturizer my face felt the most hydrated it has in quite some time. The smell isn't bad in my opinion, but I really like the water based texture from this moisturizer. A little goes a long ways as well! My skin is normally combination of oily and dry but some days it has a mind of its own whether one day it wants to be dry and then another day it wants to be oily. I wish it would last all day as I have applied it in the morning before I went to work, but then I also sweat at work all the time. I will definitely be buying this again.

I have sensitive dry skin now my skin used to be very oily with aging. My skin has changed. I got this as a gift. I tried it very similar to the Neutrogena Hydro boost smells great. It's moisturizing, but not too thick which I hate thick greasy moisturizer definitely a win.
This leaves your skin feeling super moisturized but not heavy like some creams can. It smells good and leaves my skin feeling freshly moisturized for a long time. I just wish it was more affordable.
I use this lightweight moisturizer daily after I wash my face. I like how it isn't greasy at all and has a pleasant, light fragrance.
Love how this feels on my face! It's refreshing and I personally feel comfortable not putting makeup on afterwards!!

This moisturizer has a great texture and seeps into the skin well. However, if you are sensitive to smell, this might be too much for you. I cannot get over how it smells like Pledge dust cleaning spray.

avis.titre: Holy grail for oily yet dehydrated skin
avis.texte: Love love love the product. Perfect for oily yet dehydrated skin. Will repurchase again for we

avis.titre: I have the MOST sensitive skin
avis.texte: I don't even know how much I have spent on skincare because everything makes my skin burn. Until now, I will never not use this, I love it. Super gentle on my skin, even around my eyes. Highly recommended.
I had heard good things about this moisturizer. Wanted to give it a try. I think its better for younger skin because its very light weight and not moisturizing enough for mature skin

I love this. I apply after LaRoche Posay Hyalu B5. I find that it keeps my skin hydrated and soft all day WITHOUT FEELING TACKY OR HEAVY!!! I took it to my yearly body scan at the dermatologist and she looked it over, typed a few things in her computer and said "Yes! This is good!" I was relieved since I had already grown to like it and did not want to switch. The price is good and I am a rewards member so if you are reading this and you think the price seems high, maybe use some of your Ulta Rewards points to help offset the cost. I'm to the point where I have tried so many things for my menopause-era skin and I buy what works w/o worrying too much about the cost.

avis.titre: They added Squalene and now I breakout
avis.texte: This used to work for me but not anymore. I was breaking out for the first time in forever and was using this. I checked the ingredients and it now has squalene in it-that always breaks me out. So into thd garbage. It used fo be great.

I have used this for years. It is a lightweight moisturizer that plumps my skin. I use it in the morning after cleaning and before makeup. It is non greasy and long lasting after application. The firming effect is great for my mature skin. Highly recommend for any age.

I purchased this belief "True Cream Aqua Bomb" in the mini size to try it out. This gel is rich & creamy and you do not need to use a lot of it. It absorbs fast and is fragrance free. I do feel my skin looks firmer.

avis.titre: I got this as a free sample and LOVE it!
avis.texte: I'm so glad I tried out this free sample when I got it. It instantly makes your face feel moisturized. I've tried a lot of products and I'm over 60 now. I have never felt like my face was so smooth and refreshed after using a product, but this one is the bomb! I love it so much, I ordered the moisturizer also to see how that works. This is more of a serum that hydrates.

avis.titre: Belif me when I tell you this is the Bomb!
avis.texte: I rarely do reviews and only when I really feel I can recommend a product. I've been using belif True Cream- Aqua Bomb Hydrating Moisturizer since Fall of 2024 and have enjoyed it since day one. It has a very nice gel-like consistency, a light botanical fragrance, absorbs quickly, and provides a nice base for makeup that doesn't pill. I'm in my late 50s so dryness is more of a concern but still get the occasional blemish. I also have sensitive skin and this moisturizer is very safe and gentle to my skin. It feels so refreshing when I put it on in the morning and in the evening after washing my face. It's the part of my skin care routine that I look forward to the most!
Used to be the only thing i could use without breaking me out but with the new formula the added ingredients already have broke me out-_- Go back to old formula PLS PLS PLS
I absolutely love this bomb , it's like giving your face an immediate drink of water . It leaves my face feeling refreshed and glowing.

I go back to this moisturizer time and time again, due to the fact that it is the most beautiful texture & delivers consistent results. Water-gel texture, no harsh fragrances, makes skin instantly feel smoother and also looks great under makeup. I recommend this constantly for my dehydrated friends!

I got this product as a sample and fell in love almost immediately. It's not greasy like most lotions and creams and it absorbs quickly. However, it's not labeled as cruelty free which is a big no from me. I googled it to find they do sell to mainland China, where animal testing is still required. So even though Belif doesn't test on animals themselves, they sell to countries that do. Unfortunate and disappointing, but no thanks!
I absolutely love this product, it makes my skin very smooth

This is a great winter/very dry skin moisturizer. I have dry skin in the winter and for me it worked well but left my skin quite tacky and refused ro absorb. I don't mind that but under makeup it's kind of a nightmare.
My skin is so dry and senstive and reactive. J have tried every moisturizer out there and this is by FAR the best. Worth every single cent! Can't recommend enough
Quite a good and luxurious face cream, which doesn't feel too heavy. This is the first product my husband has ever stolen from me, and we've been married for over 10 years!
My face feels so smooth and supple and plump using this gel cream! My skin absolutely drinks it all in!

I have very dry skin and it is very picky! Never thought that a gel based product would work for me but it does. I apply it over sunscreen during the day and it doesn't pill like every other product. It also has a light, fresh, and beautiful scent. I'm a repeat customer.

after i had moved to florida, i needed a moisturizer to help revive my skin. i hadn't used skincare in almost 2 weeks bc everything was packed away somewhere so i needed hydration FAST. i got recommended this moisturizer, and buying this was a game-changer!! this really does deliver hydration in SECONDS + even in the mirror , i could see my skin becoming more and more hydrated over time. i learned that a lil goes a long way , so to make it last, i used it in the morning , so my skin could feel hydrated + new all day !! now if you're reading this, then let me tell you that you NEED to try this moisturizer ! your skin can thank me later .

I used this moisturizer a couple years ago but I then stopped using it because I wanted to experiment which one works best on me. I found myself going back to this one (aqua bomb), and it is amazing. It doesn't break you out, it soothes well, stays on your face all day, and doesn't grease you up. This is by far the BEST moisturizer I've used by far. I have recommended it to friends and they love it. I have a combination skin type, but within each season it feels different, but still, this is magic on your skin

I went through 2 jars of this and loved the way my skin looked and felt. Third time was a disaster. My face is breaking out in hard bright red patches and is burning starting with the first use of latest jar. So bummed, can't use or recommend after loving so much.
I love this moisturizer so much. It's light and feels so soft on my face after applying, almost like powder. The scent is so nice too.
I've been using This moisturizer for a year I love it. I've seen great results with using it consistently.
I was given a small size to try, its incredible. Will definitely purchase!!!

Got a free sample of this (foil packet) and really liked it. Bought it on a 5x points sale (love those). Am enjoying it. I have seen a lot less dryness in my skin since I started using this. I have combo skin...T zone oil but dry around mouth corners and centers of cheeks. I'm in my early 50s.
I really like this moisturizer. I tried it for the first time and it absorbs quickly but is moisturizing gor my combo skin.

Got a mini ans simoly fell in love so ofc I had to get the full size. I really like the moisturizer and would say it really works for all skin types!

Certainly! Here's a suggestion for a short and positive review: The Belif True Cream Aqua Bomb is a game-changer for anyone seeking lightweight yet deeply hydrating skincare. Its gel-like texture absorbs instantly, leaving my skin feeling refreshed, smooth, and perfectly balanced without any greasy residue. I love how it delivers intense moisture while keeping my skin breathable, making it perfect for daily use and under makeup. A must-have for maintaining a healthy, radiant complexion!
I loved this moisturizer until they changed the formula. My skin hates niacinamide.
Love this stuff and this company I want to see more of this company products online and in the store. Why is it not being sold in the stores or online like it's always sold out I want this people.
This is amazing for summer time (when don't need sooo much moisturizer), or you want something light. I love using it with spf or by itself in the warmer months.
I love the entire Aqua Bomb line. The moisturizer is by far my favorite. It is better than any of the $100+ moisturizers I've used.
Love the Belif products. Work perfectly on my very sensitive skin.
The texture feels amazing! I have very sensitive skin and this has felt so creamy and smooth on my skin with no break outs. Def recommend!

avis.titre: It's a big no for me

I'd also like to mention that I do not have sensitive skin and have never had a reaction to a product like this before :(

Have dry skin feels soo refreshing on the skin, feels light weight doesnt feel heavy or greasy. Great hydration noticed it has helped with my redness. Great staple in my skincare rouitine would definitely recommend!!

avis.titre: I'm so sad… the new formula disappoints
avis.texte: Belif Aqua Bomb has been my go to moisturizer since it came out. The blue gel was cool and soothing for my sensitive skin. The new formula is kind of the opposite. I was excited to try it, because Belif is always so soothing. This isn't soothing at least not for me. With 30 seconds of putting it on my face, I look like I have very bad sunburn and it feels like I have very bad sunburn. I am so bummed - the original was perfect!
This is my holy grail. I used so many different moisturizers from Tatcha to Drunk Elephant but Belif's Aqua Bomb is still the bessst in term of moisturizing and how light it feels on my skin after.

Belif was my go to for years but they reformulated their products and they are awful. Highly fragranced and broke me out in cystic acne. I'm so so bummed. Please go back to the original formula before you lose customers you've had for years as well as newbies who had high hopes!!

I have used this moisturizer for a couple years now. I have tried different ones due to being a little on the higher end, but have always come back to this moisturizer. I have oily acne prone skin and this is the only moisturizer that does not break me out. I will continue to buy.
It's light enough that I don't feel like I'm left with a layer of goo on my face but moisturizing enough to leave me waking up looking dewy and my skin feeling so soft. Love it.

I love this cream, its texture is gel, super light and it absorbs quickly into my face while leaving it moisturised. Its effect is matte so it doesn't leave my face shiny at all. Its packaging is minimalist and

the first time i ever used this product, i was thinking "oh my goodness, this stuff is the most moisturizing face cream that has ever touched my skin… wow" after the product was applied, my skin had absolutely NO oily residue, no cast left… it left nothing BUT the most plump and softened skin ive ever had! im trying not to be dramatic but seriously this is the best face cream ive ever used. hands down.
this is my summer moisturizer that I have used for many years. I have recommended to countless people. I suffer from rosacea and outbreaks are painful. Aqua Bomb is soothing on it.
This is soooo moisturizing! Would absolutely recommend this to ANYONE. So lightweight, so smoothing, and my skin basically drinks this!

Was looking for something that was very moisturizing but also would not make me break out. This is defiantly it, it is not to oily either. Especially in the winter when my skin tends to need a little extra moisture. My boyfriend also uses this and absolutely love its.

I have combo skin, and was on a hunt for a new moisturizer. After reading the reviews on this one, I decided to give it a try. I have used it for around a week now, and will be returning it. It sat heavy on my skin, and never would fully absorb. It made me look at feel greasy, and it pilled pretty badly.
Belief Aqua bomb is a worldwide seller. It's extremely moisturizing and since I have dry skin, I really enjoy the hydration it gives. It's a gel like cream that gives a LOT of hydration to the skin.
This is the best moisturizer I have used. It works for my mature skin. I would recommend this if you have dry skin.

I'm usually a budget skincare girlie but I got a sample of this and have kept repurchasing. I love this on my skin at night. I use benzoyl peroxide and retinol and this still is able to keep my skin hydrated.

avis.titre: BIG NO to the reformulated Aqua Bomb
avis.texte: Why change a good thing?? I used Aqua Bomb for years it was my holy grail moisturizer, never got greasy from it and it was so refreshing to use. They recently reformulated this product adding niacinimide, and the hydration is supposed to be "longer lasting." The only long lasting thing about it is the grease-ball effect I get after 8 hours of wear and little comedomes to round out the look. Bring back the original formula please!

New formulation has changed this product away from why I originally liked it (had been using for nearly a decade). If you need an occlusive (sealing layer moisturizer) thats oiky skin friendly - this might be a good try It dries down with a thin smoothing silicone layer that sits on the skin and seals in products underneath WHAT CHANGED- does not feel as deeply hydrating / plumping, or skin calming. I had used prviously formulation as a deeply hydrating night moisturizer with great results; woke up with reduced fine lines, redness on skin resuced, more even complexion. Now this is nothing special.

I have combination skin and this has been my go to for YEARS. Its the only thing that deeply moisturizes my skin, doesnt cause breakouts, and it reasonably priced. This can withstand the most humid and coldest climates.

I got this as a sample and I will definitely be buying more. Its silky smooth and makes my skin feel so soft. Its not greasy and it doesnt irritate my skin. Probably one of my fave facial moisturizers.

This is my go to daily moisturizer. It works perfectly for me. I love the gel like texture, it feels lightweight and still keeps me moisturized. I have normal skin with occasional dry patches in winter and some shine in summer. I have tried a lot of moisturizers but still reach for this over my pricier Tatcha, DE, Fresh and Charlotte Tilbury ones.
I love this stuff- I never feel greasy or gross after using it. Smells nice, too, which is a plus.

This was my holy grail. If i couldn't get anything else in my skincare routine, this was my non-negotiable. They recently reformulated and my skin hates it 😭 small bumps all over my face. I spent years trying out products until I finally came across this one, used it for the past 5 years, and unfortunately this last change they made didn't agree with my skin at all. I'll miss her 💔
I Love it !!! It absorbed so well. Feels nice and cool . My skin feels Soo soft !!!

I've been using this moisturizer since around 2019, and it has never failed to keep my oily skin hydrated. I especially love using it in the summer, and it pairs and wears well with my other skincare products and my sunscreen. I will always repurchase

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again.
avis.texte: I used this product after cleansing my skin. It left it so hydrating and soft, I was in shock!

I received this free product called Belif The True Cream, Aqua Bomb from Bzz Agent and let me tell you, its AMAZING!! I will be purchasing this item in the future and would recommend it to anyone with dry skin or combination skin. I use it as a daily moisturizer. It has a very good and clean smell that's not to strong and it applies to my face so well. Unlike some moisturizers that I have used in the past that would be thick and leave my skin oily, this product goes on so smooth, and I could feel the difference in the texture of my skin instantly. I have finally found my daily moisturizing product to use in my daily skincare routine.

The True Cream Aqua Bomb is a very nice face hydrator. I live with very dry skin and the winter months are so hard on my ability to keep my skin hydrated. The Aqua Bomb is very light so I was thinking my skin would just quickly absorb it and I would need to apply more. That pleasantly wasn't the case. My face felt hydrated all day and didn't leave a heavy cream feeling at all. Its scent is pleasant and clean.

avis.titre: This feels amazing for my thirsty skin!
avis.texte: From the very first moment that I tried this cream, I was impressed with how my skin so readily absorbed it. My skin felt quenched right away without feeling greasy. I have very dry skin and this helps get moisture locked in to my skin, and is a great base to put my makeup over. It plumped up my skin and reduced the appearance of the fine lines and ruddy skin around my eyes. Glad I tried this product and will continue to use.

such a beautiful moisturizer! soft, leaves your skin feeling soft and hydrated. performs well wonderfully with sunscreen & makeup as well! the niacinamide was a fantastic addition to this formula!! not only are you getting great hydration with one application, youre also getting some gentle smoothing and brightening with consistent use. would 110% repurchase and recommend!

avis.titre: Great product even better on a sunburn
avis.texte: This product was seriously a miracle worker on my dehydrated skin. I was using this prior to going on vacation and loved the moisturizing effects it had without leaving my skin greasy. On vacation I got burned even using sunscreen and this product was seriously a life saver. It helped moisturize my skin so much it didn't even peel like it normally with after a burn. It's truly a great product. A little bit goes a long way usage wise too!

avis.titre: The name aqua bomb is no joke!
avis.texte: This is a moisturizer I find myself always going back to. I have extremely dry skin and not a lot of moisturizers keep my skin feeling hydrated throughout the entire day but this one absolutely does. It instantly relieves my dry skin and makes it feel much more plump.

Due to a medical issue I cannot drink a lot of fluids so my skin is always dry and thirsty. When I used this the first time my skin drank it up! It's great for use morning and night. Before sunscreen or my thicker night cream. It smells lovely, and really sinks into your skin. i'm a new fan.

I really love the Belif Aqua Bomb True Cream. I use it as a nighttime moisturizer over retinol and it keeps my skin super moisturized throughout the night. I think my skin actually looks brighter. I also like the light, clean smell. I received the product in exchange for an honest review.
I absolutely love this aqua bomb! It absorbs into skin, leaving your skin soft and moisturized! The scent is very light. I will definitely be adding this to my daily routine.
